chunks: From him, from Salih, from one of his companions, from Abdul Samad ibn Basheer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The whale that carries the earth secretly said to itself that it carries the earth by its own strength. So Allah, the Exalted, sent to it a fish smaller than a palm's length and larger than a finger. It entered its nostrils and stunned it, and it remained like that for forty days. Then Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, was compassionate to it and had mercy on it, and it went out. So whenever Allah, the Glorious and Mighty, intends an earthquake for the earth, He sends that fish to that fish. When it sees it, it trembles, and the earth shakes.

key_terms.أَسَرَّ فِي نَفْسِهِ: Secretly said to itself / internal monologue
key_terms.فِتْر: A small finger / digit (unit of measurement)

ai.seo_question: What is the reason for earthquakes according to Shia hadith about the whale carrying the earth?
ai.summary: This cosmological narrative from al-Kafi illustrates the concept of divine humility (tawhid) by showing how Allah humbled the whale's arrogance through a smaller creature, linking physical phenomena to spiritual lessons. The forty-day period of stupor and the subsequent trembling mechanism provide a traditional Shia explanation for earthquakes as signs of Allah's power and mercy. This hadith is often cited in discussions on the unseen world (ghayb) and the interconnectedness of creation's layers.

en.hubeali: H 14813 – From him, from Salih, from one of his companions, from Abdul Samad Bin Basheer, who has reported the following: Abu Abdullahasws has said that:

‘The whale which is carrying the earth secretly said to itself that it is carrying the earth by its own strength. So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the High Sent to it a fish smaller than a palm’s length, and larger than a finger. So it entered in its gills and shocked it. It remained like that for forty days. Then Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Raised it and was Merciful to it, and Took it out. So whenever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Intends the earth to be in a quake, He<sup>azwj</sup> Sends that (small) fish to that (big) fish. So when it sees it, it becomes restless, so the earth gets engulfed by the earthquake’.
en.sarwar: 366. From him, from Salih, from one of his companions, from Abdul Samad Bin Basheer, who has reported the following:

Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has said that: ‘The whale which is carrying the earth secretly said to itself that it is carrying the earth by its own strength. So Allah (azwj) the High Sent to it a fish smaller than a palm’s length, and larger than a finger. So it entered in its gills and shocked it. It remained like that for forty days. Then Allah (azwj) Raised it and was Merciful to it, and Took it out. So whenever Allah (azwj) Intends the earth to be in a quake, He (azwj) Sends that (small) fish to that (big) fish. So when it sees it, it becomes restless, so the earth gets engulfed by the earthquake’.
